cands.name: Jennifer Jenkins
cands.bio: Democratic nominee. Brevard County School Board member (District 3) Nov 2020-Nov 2024; defeated incumbent Tina Descovich, a Moms for Liberty co-founder, in 2020. Former teacher; founder of Educated We Stand. Ran for U.S. Senate, then District 6, before switching to District 8 in May 2026 after the new map.
cands.local_ties: Lives in Brevard County; campaign mailing address in Satellite Beach. District 8 covers the Space Coast and an Orlando/UCF-area portion.

record.text: Served on the Brevard Public Schools board (District 3) from Nov 17, 2020 to Nov 19, 2024; unseated incumbent Tina Descovich in 2020 (Florida Phoenix / Florida Press summaries).

Campaign positions (ClickOrlando guide): federal reinsurance for property insurance, opposes tariffs, expand Medicaid and restore ACA subsidies, protect Dept. of Education, moratorium on data centers.

endorsements.text: Per Wikipedia's District 8 page: Florida AFL-CIO, Rep. Kathy Castor, Alex Vindman, Vote Mama.

cands.name: Mike Haridopolos
cands.bio: Republican, U.S. House since January 2025. Former Florida Senate President (2010-2012), state Senator 2003-2012 and state Representative 2000-2003; history instructor (Brevard/UF), consultant and lobbyist. Chairs the House Space and Aeronautics subcommittee.
cands.local_ties: Lives in Indian Harbour Beach (Brevard County). New District 8 covers the Space Coast (Brevard) and part of the Orlando/UCF area.

record.text: Committees: Financial Services (Capital Markets; Digital Assets/FinTech/AI; Oversight) and Science, Space and Technology (Chair, Space and Aeronautics subcommittee).
Lead sponsor of CS/SJR 2 (2011), a joint resolution titled 'Health Care Services'; passed the Florida Senate 29-10 on March 9, 2011 (he voted Yea).
Campaign site priorities: stopping illegal immigration, economy, national debt, Indian River Lagoon, space; supports term limits and a congressional stock-trading ban, opposes single-payer.

money_notes.text: Wikipedia cites a 2017 Florida Politics report of potential lobbying fees near $500K in one quarter while out of office (he owns MJH Consulting).

endorsements.text: Endorsed for re-election by President Trump and AIPAC, per Wikipedia's District 8 page.
